# Borough Kitchen

> A London-based cook shop and culinary school offering premium kitchenware, professional cookware collections, and hands-on cooking classes across multiple locations.

Borough Kitchen specializes in high-quality cookware from brands like Mauviel, De Buyer, and Staub, alongside comprehensive cooking instruction. The business operates physical stores in London neighborhoods including Borough Market, Battersea, and Chiswick, serving both home cooks and culinary enthusiasts.

## Cookware Collections

- [Pots & Pans - Cookware Sets & Individuals | Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/pots-pans): Pots and pans collection featuring De Buyer, Mauviel professional cookware
- [Kitchen Cookware Sets - Pots & Pans Sets - Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/cookware-sets): Professional cookware sets from Mauviel, Hestan, and other premium brands
- [Saucepans, Sauté Pans and More | Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/saucepans-saute-pans): Professional saucepans and sauté pans including Mauviel copper cookware
- [Frying Pans, Skillet Pans & Griddle Pans | Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/frying-pans-skillets-griddles): Frying pans, skillets, and griddles in various materials and finishes
- [Roasting Dishes, Pans & Racks | Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/roasting-pans-and-dishes): Roasting pans, dishes, and racks from Mauviel and other premium brands
- [Casserole Dishes, Stock Pots & Cocottes - Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/casserole-cocottes-stock-pots): Casserole dishes, stock pots, and cocottes including Staub products
- [Crepe & Pancake Pans | Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/crepe-pans): Crepe and pancake pans in multiple materials from De Buyer, Staub, Lodge
- [Bain Marie Pots & Double Boilers - Borough Kitchen](https://www.boroughkitchen.com/collections/bain-maries): Bain marie pots and double boilers from Mauviel for specialized cooking
